declarations.name: AuiPromptInput
declarations.description:
AbsoluteUI PromptInput: `<aui-prompt-input>`.
Implements ControlValueAccessor and Validator (error key `aui`); `[(value)]` without forms.

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Label and accessible name of the text field.

inputs.name: hideLabel
inputs.description: Visually hide the label; it remains the accessible name.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: Form field name.

inputs.name: placeholder
inputs.description: Supplementary hint; never replaces the label.

inputs.name: description
inputs.description: Help text referenced by aria-describedby.

inputs.name: required
inputs.description: Empty text (without attachments) is invalid.

inputs.name: disabled
inputs.description: Disables the field and its buttons.

inputs.name: status
inputs.description: Reply state: sending locks the field and shows a spinner; streaming turns Send into Stop.

inputs.name: rows
inputs.description: Visible rows when empty (integer 1..40).

inputs.name: maxRows
inputs.description: The field grows up to this many rows, then scrolls (integer >= rows).

inputs.name: maxLength
inputs.description: Limit in counter units (characters, or the units of count); validated, not truncated.

inputs.name: showCounter
inputs.description: Show the counter; requires maxLength.

inputs.name: count
inputs.description: Counter hook, for example a tokenizer; returns the size of the text in its own units.

inputs.name: counterUnit
inputs.description: Unit in the counter text; default characters, or tokens when count is set.

inputs.name: attachments
inputs.description: Show the attach button and accept pasted or dropped files.

inputs.name: accept
inputs.description: Accepted MIME types (image/*) or extensions (.pdf); empty accepts any.

inputs.name: maxFiles
inputs.description: Most files attached at once (integer 1..100).

inputs.name: maxFileSize
inputs.description: Largest file in bytes, or null for no limit.

inputs.name: triggers
inputs.description: Suggestions popups for trigger characters: { char, suggest(query) } (slash commands, mentions).

inputs.name: showHint
inputs.description: Show the keyboard hint (how to send and add a line) under the field.

inputs.name: icons
inputs.description: Icon slot overrides (send, stop, attach, remove, file, error).

inputs.name: submitKey
inputs.description: Enter sends (Shift+Enter adds a line), or Ctrl/Cmd+Enter sends (Enter adds a line).

inputs.name: validationTiming
inputs.description: When validation messages first appear; afterwards they update live.

inputs.name: locale
inputs.description: Message and number-formatting locale.

models.name: value
models.description: The value: `[(value)]` without forms; with Angular forms, bind the form control instead.

outputs.name: valueInput
outputs.description: User edited the text: { value, validity }.

outputs.name: changed
outputs.description: User committed the text (native change, on blur).

outputs.name: sent
outputs.description: User sent: { text, attachments }; prevent it to keep the text and files in the field.

outputs.name: stopped
outputs.description: User pressed Stop while status is streaming.

outputs.name: attachmentsChange
outputs.description: Files were attached or removed by the user: { attachments, rejected }.

outputs.name: suggestionSelected
outputs.description: A suggestion was inserted: { trigger, suggestion }.

properties.name: formState
properties.description: Angular form state of this control.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Send like the Send button: emits the cancelable aui-send and clears the field unless prevented; false when nothing was sent.

methods.name: setAttachments
methods.description: Replace the attached files (no events; limits are not applied).

methods.name: addFiles
methods.description: Add files as if the user picked them: limits apply, aui-attachment-change is emitted; returns the refused files.

methods.name: openFilePicker
methods.description: Open the file chooser (attachments must be enabled).

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clear the text and the attachments (no events).

methods.name: reportValidity
methods.description: Show messages now and return validity.

methods.name: setCustomError
methods.description: External error; cleared when the user edits.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Restore the initial text, remove attachments, and clear dirty/touched/submitted state.

accessibility.pattern: Native <textarea> with a <label for> association (HTML); suggestions follow the APG listbox with aria-activedescendant on the text field.

limitations: The token counter is a hook: AbsoluteUI ships no tokenizer.
Suggestions open above the field inside the component; they are not in the top layer, so an ancestor with overflow hidden can clip them.
Without native `field-sizing` support, auto-grow measures on input and on render only.
